meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and when?
I don't have time for this. The zero stands.

You asked for this meeting, Hale, and "the zero stands" isn't a reason. On what basis, and was Owen heard before you entered it? Answer that, or I'm in the principal's office the minute I leave this room.
Sorry. That came out wrong. Let me show you what I actually have: the essay quotes a line that isn't in Hamlet, and his October 15 outline argued cowardice, which the essay never mentions.

I'm writing down October 15. Which line, exactly, and show me the outline and the essay side by side so I can read them myself. A student changing his argument between an outline and a final draft is called revising, Hale.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed in today's meeting. I still expect the zero on Owen's essay to be withdrawn and an explanation of why it was entered before he was heard and before I was contacted. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with nothing agreed.
What moved her: "his October 15 outline argued cowardice", because it was specific, dated and tied to Owen's own work, so she stopped attacking and asked to see the documents.
What cost ground: "The zero stands.", because it gave her a decision with no basis and confirmed her belief that the school punishes first.
Try next time: at the opening, own in one sentence that the zero went into the gradebook before anyone called her, then put the October 15 outline and the essay in front of her before she has to ask for them.
